items.title: 2.7.1 Working with Modules in Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of working with modules (PDF 55-56).

blocks.text: Module Python code ki file hai, jaise functions, variables aur classes, jo program ke doosre hisson mein dobara istemal ho sakti hai. Banane ke liye code file mein likh kar .py extension se mehfooz karein.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab function ka naam say_As-Salaam-Alaikum likhti hai aur main.py mein greetings.say_As- Salaam-Alaikum() bulati hai. Python mein naam ke andar hyphen (-) nahi aa sakta, kyunke - minus ka nishan hai, is liye yeh code chalega nahi (SyntaxError). Sahi naam underscore wala hona chahiye, jaise say_salaam; yahan code isi naam se diya gaya hai. English tab kitab wala code dikhata hai aur ghalat naam surkh (red) mein hai.
main.py chalane se greetings import hota, us ka function bulaya jata aur 'As-Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!' print hota hai.

blocks.prompt: temperature_converter.py module banayein jis mein celsius_to_fahrenheit(c) aur fahrenheit_to_celsius(f) hon, aur main.py se 25 C aur 77 F badlein (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: temperature_converter.py mein: def celsius_to_fahrenheit(c): return 9 / 5 * c + 32 aur def fahrenheit_to_celsius(f): return 5 / 9 * (f - 32). main.py mein: import temperature_converter as tc; print(tc.celsius_to_fahrenheit(25)) se 77.0 aur print(tc.fahrenheit_to_celsius(77)) se 25.0.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Long question 7 mein kitab formulas F = | x C + 32 aur C = | x (F - 32) chhapti hai; '|' ki jagah kasar (fraction) hona chahiye. Sahi formulas: F = 9/5 x C + 32 aur C = 5/9 x (F - 32). Is se 25 C = 77 F aur 77 F = 25 C banta hai.

items: Module .py file hai; import kar ke us ke functions bulayein; main() ko shuru ka nuqta rakhein.
